predictions.selection_reason: User-uploaded file content -> JSON.parse without validation -> potential prototype pollution or object injection
predictions.source_summary: records parameter comes from _text which is file content read via fs.readFile from uploaded .etherpad files processed through formidable file upload handler
predictions.sink_summary: Parsed JSON objects are written to database via db.set() calls for each key-value pair after rewriting padId in keys
predictions.guard_summary: No validation, sanitization, or schema checking of JSON content before parsing; file extension check (.etherpad) but no content validation
predictions.risk_pattern: User-uploaded file content directly parsed as JSON without validation, then written to database keys and values
predictions.context_summary: HTTP POST /p/:pad/import -> formidable file upload -> .etherpad file content -> JSON.parse -> database writes
unresolved_facts: Exact database schema and impact of arbitrary key-value writes
Whether db.set() performs any validation or escaping
Presence of other security controls in database layer

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Untrusted JSON deserialization leading to database injection or object property injection
retrieval_query.sensitive_operation: db.set with user-controlled keys and values

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
